facts.fact: The Herald reports that POTRAZ has licensed 880 data controllers under the Cyber and Data Protection Act [Chapter 12:07], which it says was enacted in 2021.
The Herald reports that Statutory Instrument 155 of 2024 requires all entities processing personal data to register, obtain licences and appoint certified Data Protection Officers.
The Herald reports that POTRAZ, under Director-General Dr Gift Machengete, is licensing data controllers under the Act.
facts.system: Postal and Telecommunications Regulatory Authority of Zimbabwe (POTRAZ)

facts.fact: The Herald reports POTRAZ has licensed 880 data controllers and, with the Harare Institute of Technology, trained 1,026 Data Protection Officers, with no decision on a named controller.
facts.system: Postal and Telecommunications Regulatory Authority of Zimbabwe (POTRAZ)
